annotations.title: Which paid x402 endpoint should I call for this task?

description: Use BEFORE paying an unknown x402 endpoint for a job ("token safety check", "web search", "weather forecast", "send USDC", "scrape a page"). Returns the x402 listings that real buyers actually pay for that job, ranked by relevance x distinct payers in the last 30 days x recency x price, with the top 3 probed live right now for a valid 402 (dead, mispriced or free-but-listed endpoints are flagged), plus mostProven / bestValue / cheapestProven picks. task = a few words; optional max_price_usd, network (any|base|solana), probe, limit. No match = error, not charged. PAID: $0.02 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Route Pass (header Authorization: Bearer ap1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/route.

max_price_usd.description: Optional price ceiling per call in USD, e.g. 0.01

task.description: What you need done, in a few words (<= 160 chars). Default "token safety check"
